intents.meaning: The caller explicitly asks to understand whether, where, or how Woxza could help their business. This includes direct product-value questions, workflow or integration questions, and tailored explanation requests in any supported language or everyday dialect. A caller merely sharing their business, process, channel, pain point, scale, or desired outcome does not express this intent.
requiredContext: current process, channel, pain point, or desired outcome
intents.nextBehavior: Prepare only approved capabilities relevant to known caller facts. Ask at most the missing, high-value context questions, then give one grounded tailored pitch.
